summary: One typed notification-envelope path for every M5 producer — shell, notebooks, tasks, AI, collaboration, incidents, operator, managed policy, companion, security, continuity, and support — routed deterministically against active window, focus, do-not-disturb, presentation/follow, screen-reader, collaboration role, and user/admin policy. Every decision keeps a durable in-product record, shares one stable action target across the activity center, OS notification, companion, and badge, never widens privacy on fanout, and never lets an out-of-window surface bypass the in-product preview/approval flow.

producers.label: Shell command result
producers.summary: Command results and undo affordances route through the typed envelope instead of a surface-local toast.

producers.label: Notebook cell run
producers.summary: Notebook cell and run outcomes emit the typed envelope rather than an inline banner.

producers.label: Task run failed
producers.summary: Long-running task failures emit the typed envelope with a retry action instead of a toast-only error.

producers.label: AI awaiting approval
producers.summary: AI / agent handoffs awaiting review route through the typed envelope and the in-product preview/approval flow.

producers.label: Collaboration review requested
producers.summary: Shared review requests emit the typed envelope so every device opens the same review.

producers.label: Incident thread opened
producers.summary: New incident threads emit the typed envelope rather than a surface-local alert.

producers.label: Operator fleet alert
producers.summary: Managed fleet alerts emit the typed envelope consumed by the read-only operator dashboard.

producers.label: Managed policy changed
producers.summary: Managed policy and bundle changes emit the typed envelope that reopens the policy diff.

producers.label: Companion fanout status
producers.summary: Cross-client continuation and fanout status emit the typed envelope rather than an ad hoc cross-client banner.

producers.label: Security credential revoked
producers.summary: Credential revocation and trust advisories emit the typed envelope that breaks through with a redacted summary.

producers.label: Continuity restore complete
producers.summary: Backup, restore, and failover outcomes emit the typed envelope rather than a surface-local success toast.

producers.label: Support export ready
producers.summary: Support-export and diagnostic-bundle notices emit the typed envelope that reopens the evidence packet.

invariants.statement: Every M5 producer routes through the typed notification envelope and retains no surface-local toast/banner/badge logic, and every subsystem has a producer.
Every envelope carries a source subsystem, scope, privacy class, severity, non-empty dedupe key, non-empty recommended surface set, and a stable action target.
In every decision, every surface outcome references the one stable action target the source envelope declares.
Every decision delivers the in-app activity center as a durable record, so no attention lives only in an ephemeral toast.
When an out-of-window surface is deferred or suppressed, the in-app durable record is still delivered, so suppression and quiet-hours state stay separate from the durable object.
Every out-of-window surface outcome applies a redaction at least as strong as the envelope default and the channel's privacy ceiling, so privacy never widens on fanout.
For every envelope whose action target routes through preview/approval, no out-of-window surface executes it inline; each hands off to the in-product surface.
Re-running the routing engine on every decision's envelope and context yields an identical decision, so routing is reproducible in support export and diagnostics.
The routing contexts exercise the active-window, focus, do-not-disturb, presentation/follow, screen-reader, collaboration-role, and user/admin-policy routing inputs the contract requires.
Every envelope carries localizable title/body/action keys rather than raw copy, so message text stays revisable while the stable enums, ids, and action targets are the contract.

Every envelope scope ref, action-target object ref, and producer source ref is a repo-relative object ref or opaque aureline:// handle, never a URL, host, credential, or absolute path, so the routing decisions are safe to embed in a support export.

At least one decision routes the in-app activity center, OS notification, dock/taskbar badge, and a companion surface from one envelope, each carrying the same action target, and each of those four surface families is delivered somewhere.
Every severity, scope, privacy class, dedupe rule, channel, and reopen target the bundle uses is one the attention-routing matrix defines, and the channel routing profiles match the matrix.
Every envelope's action target names an authoritative reopen target, so a surface reopens the object rather than issuing a blind side effect.
Every recommended surface produces exactly one outcome in each of the envelope's decisions, and the in-app activity center is always among them.
